## Discovery & Translational Science

- **[Marine-derived compound shows activity against brain-eating amoebas](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/27/health-news-possible-treatment-for-brain-eating-amoebas-found-in-sea/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - Researchers isolated a novel compound from sea organisms capable of stopping *Naegleria fowleri* in preclinical evaluation.
  - The discovery provides a potential therapeutic lead for a central nervous system infection that currently carries near-total mortality.

- **[Machine learning platform inClinico prospective validation for trial success prediction](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.13.26365373)** — *bioRxiv*
  - Developed an AI platform trained on registration-time parameters (target precedent, drug modality, study design, mechanism of action) to forecast primary endpoint success across Phase I–IV clinical trials.
  - Evaluated on trials initiated in 2021 or later, the efficacy prediction model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.828 (95% CI: 0.812–0.845, n = 2,347).

- **[Targeted protein degradation advances: MAGEA11-recruiting PROTACs and CB1 molecular glues](https://www.nature.com/articles/s44386-026-00081-2)** — *npj Drug Discovery*
  - Established a tissue-selective PROTAC strategy by recruiting the E3 ligase scaffolding protein MAGEA11.
  - A parallel study in [npj Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/s44386-026-00087-w) demonstrated molecular glue-mediated degradation of cannabinoid receptor 1 (CB1) as a potential strategy for cancer therapy.

- **[Circulating midlife neurostructural proteome predicts long-term Alzheimer's disease risk](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.22.26366029)** — *bioRxiv*
  - Combined plasma proteomics and neuroimaging in UK Biobank data to identify a midlife circulating proteomic signature associated with structural brain changes.
  - The signature predicted long-term cognitive decline and incident dementia over two decades, showing genetic enrichment in microglial, astrocyte, and endothelial pathways.

- **[Divergent CNS and systemic T-cell responses in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04728-5)** — *Nature Medicine*
  - Evaluated T-cell immunity in patients with ALS, finding distinct prognostic roles between systemic circulation and cerebrospinal fluid.
  - Intrathecal antigen presentation and cytomegalovirus-specific immune activity correlated with worse clinical outcomes.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **[Big Pharma] [Bristol Myers Squibb reports fatal SAE in Phase I–II zola-cel trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/autoimmune-bristol-death-treasury-china-gilead-pepstar-zymeworks/833901/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - A patient enrolled in an early-stage multiple sclerosis study evaluating investigational CAR-T therapy zola-cel died 44 days post-infusion.
  - The participant experienced late-onset motor symptoms refractoriness to steroids, leading to septic pneumonia; no other deaths have been reported across zola-cel autoimmune trials.

- **[Big Pharma] [Roche presents ESMO data for KRAS G12C inhibitor divarasib](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/roche-kras-drug-divarasib-lung-cancer-treatment-win/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - Roche showcased clinical trial data at ESMO evaluating divarasib in patients with non-small cell lung cancer.
  - The dataset highlighted competitive anti-tumor activity for the target within the KRAS G12C space.

- **[Biotech] [Incyte highlights durable responses with INCB161734 combination in pancreatic cancer](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/incyte-esmo-pancreatic-cancer-incb161734-results/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - Early clinical trial results presented at ESMO showed that targeted agent INCB161734 combined with chemotherapy induced lasting tumor responses in selected patients with advanced pancreatic cancer.

- **[Biotech] [Beam Therapeutics demonstrates proof of concept in Phase 1/2 BEAM-301 trial](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115036320892612843)** — *BioStocks*
  - Initial clinical data from the Phase 1/2 study of BEAM-301 established clinical proof of concept for in vivo genetic correction in patients with Glycogen Storage Disease Type Ia.

- **[Biotech] [ArriVent BioPharma shares slide following ESMO CDH17 readout](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114837500032082323)** — *Jacob Plieth*
  - Shares closed down 27% following clinical data presented for its CDH17-targeted asset at ESMO 2026.
  - Market reaction reflects investor questions regarding payload release kinetics and potential systemic toxicity.

- **[Big Pharma] [BMS's iza-bren shows elevated serious safety events in ESMO presentation](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114732675793928590)** — *Jacob Plieth*
  - ESMO 2026 presentation slides for the Panku-Lung01 trial revealed a higher rate of serious treatment-related adverse events for iza-bren than previously outlined in press release communications.

- **[Early KRAS G12D inhibitor readouts detailed at ESMO](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114758689022189891)** — *Jacob Plieth*
  - Incyte's ON/OFF inhibitor demonstrated early clinical activity, though questions remain regarding overall potency.
  - Revolution Medicines' ON-only inhibitor zoldonrasib faces potential safety barriers in combination settings, having not yet initiated a trial with cetuximab, while its combination with Tango Therapeutics' PRMT inhibitor yielded modest efficacy.
  - Verastem's ON/OFF inhibitor 7375 showed linear PK/PD characteristics and a differentiated safety profile with minimal rash or stomatitis.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **[Big Pharma] [Merck and Kelun-Biotech's Trop-2 ADC sac-TMT reduces risk of death in Phase III endometrial cancer trial](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/merck-kelun-sac-tmt-endometrial-cancer-study-esmo-2026/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - Sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT) achieved a one-third reduction in the risk of death compared to standard therapy in patients with advanced endometrial cancer.
  - Detailed results presented at ESMO support global registrational plans for the Trop-2-targeted antibody-drug conjugate.

- **[Biotech] [BioNTech and DualityBio report modest PFS gain and toxicity signal in Phase III breast cancer study](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/biontech-dualitybio-modest-results-adc-breast-cancer/839574/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Trastuzumab pamirtecan met its primary endpoint of progression-free survival in HER2-low metastatic breast cancer, but investigators characterized overall efficacy as modest.
  - Trial readouts revealed higher rates of interstitial lung disease (ILD) and severe or fatal adverse events, with no statistically clear overall survival benefit observed at current follow-up.

- **[Biotech] [Moderna and Merck present detailed Phase III intismeran autogene data; targeting 2027 filing](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/esmo-2026-intismeran-melanoma-imdelltra-divarasib-kras-g12c/833921/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - A full ESMO presentation confirmed a 42% reduction in the risk of recurrence or death when personalized mRNA vaccine intismeran autogene is added to pembrolizumab in resected high-risk melanoma.
  - Moderna CEO Stéphane Bancel confirmed target FDA submission plans aiming for a 2027 launch, while experts noted logistical challenges in scaling personalized mRNA manufacturing.

- **[Big Pharma] [Pfizer's Elrexfio meets primary endpoint in Phase 3 MagnetisMM-32 trial](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115037178459832644)** — *BioStocks*
  - Elrexfio (elranatamab) met its primary endpoint in the Phase 3 MagnetisMM-32 trial, outperforming standard treatment regimens in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **[Big Pharma] [GSK prepares filings for sixth oncology approval following ESMO updates](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/gsk-cancer-esmo-adcs-jemperli/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - GSK highlighted clinical data across its pipeline, including antibody-drug conjugates and PD-1 inhibitor Jemperli, positioning the firm to seek regulatory approval for its sixth cancer drug since rebuilding its oncology portfolio.

- **[FDA issues Warning Letter to Walmart over unapproved OTC drug sales](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/walmart-inc-736557-10012026)** — *FDA*
  - The FDA released a formal Warning Letter to Walmart, Inc. citing online marketplace distributions of unapproved and misbranded over-the-counter drug products.

- **[FDA updates educational resources on biosimilars and interchangeability standards](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/biosimilars/multimedia-education-materials-biosimilars)** — *FDA*
  - The agency published expanded multi-language materials explaining substitution rules and therapeutic equivalence criteria for interchangeable biologics.

- **[Big Pharma] [FDA approves Pfizer's Talzenna combination in HRR-mutated mAPMN/S prostate cancer](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-approves-talazoparib-enzalutamide-metastatic-androgen-pathway-modulation-naive-or-sensitive)** — *FDA*
  - The FDA approved talazoparib (Talzenna) plus enzalutamide for adults with metastatic androgen pathway modulation-naïve or -sensitive prostate cancer carrying homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene mutations.
  - Approval was supported by the Phase 3 TALAPRO-3 trial (NCT04821622), which evaluated 599 patients with HRR-mutated disease.
  - FoundationOne CDx and FoundationOne Liquid CDx companion diagnostics were authorized to identify eligible patients with HRR gene alterations.

- **[Greenwich Rx issues voluntary nationwide recall of compounded glutathione](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/greenwich-rx-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-compounded-glutathione-due-elevated-endotoxin-levels)** — *FDA*
  - 503A compounding pharmacy Greenwich Rx voluntarily recalled specific lots of injectable compounded glutathione due to potential elevated endotoxin levels.

## Business & Strategy

- **[Biotech] [Corxel to go public via SPAC with $300M PIPE to fund late-stage oral GLP-1 candidate](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/corxel-pharmaceuticals-spac-public-obesity-drugs/872772/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - Corxel Pharmaceuticals agreed to a SPAC merger backed by $300 million in private investment to advance its oral GLP-1 receptor agonist CX11 into Phase III testing.
  - Phase II data showed CX11 produced up to 11.5% average weight loss at 36 weeks; Corxel will also advance a preclinical amylin program while transferring an asset licensed from Biogen to its parent entity.

- **[US Treasury escalates oversight of biopharma licensing transactions with China](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/autoimmune-bristol-death-treasury-china-gilead-pepstar-zymeworks/833901/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  - The U.S. Department of the Treasury is increasing examination of cross-border investments and licensing partnerships between domestic biopharmas and Chinese developers, impacting deals tied to Gilead, Pepstar, and Zymeworks.

- **[Amish and Mennonite community forms local biotech venture for rare disease gene therapy](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/27/gene-therapy-cow-rare-disease-amish-mennonite-patients-waiting/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - Seeking solutions for unaddressed genetic conditions, a Plain community in Pennsylvania established an independent drug development company to directly fund and manufacture gene therapies tailored to endemic rare diseases.

- **[Biotech] [Artiva Biotherapeutics discontinues AlloNK and cuts staff by 94%](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115043801433825707)** — *BioStocks*
  - Artiva halted development of its allogeneic NK cell therapy AlloNK following a benefit-risk assessment of longer-term clinical data that included two Grade 5 (fatal) adverse events.
  - The pipeline discontinuation is accompanied by a trading halt and a 94% workforce reduction.

- **[Big Pharma] [Novo Nordisk loses US court bid to block Eli Lilly advertising](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115047837670981660)** — *BioStocks*
  - A US court ruled against Novo Nordisk in its legal attempt to block Eli Lilly's weight-loss drug advertisements.

- **[Biotech] [Zura Bio maintains clinical timelines and reports cash position](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115045581152247986)** — *BioStocks*
  - Topline data for the Phase 2 TibuSHIELD trial in hidradenitis suppurativa remains scheduled for Q4.
  - Enrollment completed in the TibuSURE trial in systemic sclerosis with 91 participants randomized, exceeding target; topline data is expected in 1H 2027.
  - The company closed the period with $187.7 million in cash and cash equivalents.

## Public Health & Policy

- **[First human case of Shamonda virus reported in France](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/health-news-virus-afflicting-cows-makes-the-jump-to-humans/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - French authorities identified the first documented human infection with the bovine-associated Shamonda virus; WHO guidelines indicate broader human transmission risks remain low.

- **[HHS relaxes cybersecurity and transparency requirements for hospital EHR vendors](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/26/health-data-interoperability-hti5-relaxes-privacy-security-requirements/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - Updated HTI-5 administrative rules rolled back specific privacy, security, and transparency requirements previously imposed on electronic health record software developers.

- **[Congressional inquiry targets PBM audit practices against independent pharmacies](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/26/lawmaker-probes-pbms-for-punitive-audits-independent-pharmacies/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT News*
  - A House lawmaker initiated an investigation into whether the three largest pharmacy benefit managers used punitive audits against independent retail pharmacies as a retaliatory tactic.

- **[Enterovirus D68 surveillance reveals shift to adult demographic and subclade A2/D dominance in Europe](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.23.26366309)** — *medRxiv*
  - A multi-site study across 13 European countries identified a surge in adult infections in 2025 alongside continent-wide prevalence of the EV-D68 subclade A2/D.

- **[FDA issues policy statement on compounded drug safety oversight](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/statement-improving-adverse-event-reporting-compounded-drugs-protect-patients)** — *FDA*
  - CDER Director Janet Woodcock outlined initiatives to enhance adverse event reporting and inspection oversight for drug compounding and outsourcing facilities.
  - The agency emphasized that compounded drugs do not undergo pre-market FDA evaluation for safety, effectiveness, or manufacturing quality.

**Worth watching:** Safety signals emerging from ESMO readouts (notably ILD and Grade 5 events in ADC and cell therapy programs) alongside escalating US Treasury scrutiny of cross-border US-China biopharma licensing agreements.
